lead_html: Neotone is a digital handpan with nine main tonefields, each with a mutant tonefield inside it. This page shows what the Neotone layout looks like in Handpan Theory and gives three chord cards you can play from it.
history_html: A Neotone layout has nine main tonefields, and inside each one sits a mutant tonefield. Your top notes go in the main tonefields. Your bottom notes become the mutant notes, each linked to a main tonefield. Inner notes are not placed.

On a chord card the main tonefields are the large circles and each mutant tonefield is the small lens inside its circle. The notes in the chord light up, so you can see which main and mutant notes to strike together.
steps_html: Open the app and tap + ADD A SCALE.
Type your scale, top notes first.
Tap GENERATE CARDS, then practice every chord card for your own pan.
